summary: List the automation library for the active project (no slug) OR fetch one automation with rendered prompt preview (with slug). System automations are global; user automations only surface inside their project.

params.name: slug
params.doc: Omit for the list view; pass to fetch a single automation + rendered_prompt + resolved_variables + install_hint.

params.name: theme
params.doc: List filter by theme (validated against VALID_THEMES; only checked in list view). Unknown theme -> bad_request error.

params.name: channel_label
params.doc: Folded into the single-automation rendered prompt preview (single-get only).

params.name: variables
params.doc: Override values folded into the rendered preview (single-get only).

params.name: show_all
params.doc: List view: if False, hides automations whose required platforms aren't connected (but still shows featured ones, flagged needs_connection=true). True shows everything.

returns: List: { automations:[serialized], total, themes:[{key,label}], browse_url }. Single: { id,slug,title,...,prompt_template, resolved_variables, rendered_prompt, install_hint }. | {error,error_type,message}
